description: VN→ZH classifier over-generalization (张 family): Vietnamese learners default to 个, but flat objects (纸/票/照片/地图/桌子/床) take 张. Rule zh-ge-to-zhang rewrites 个 → 张 for a closed flat-object noun.
fp_risk_note: Low risk. Rewrites 个 → 张 only before a closed flat-object noun (纸/票/照片/地图/桌子/床) after a number/demonstrative. Compounds (纸巾, 票房, 票价) are guarded by tail lookaheads; nouns that genuinely take 个 (人, 苹果) are not in the map.

positive.notes: 一个照片 → 一张照片.
这个桌子 → 这张桌子 (demonstrative).

negative.notes: 人 genuinely takes 个 — not in the map, must abstain.
票房 (box-office takings) — 票 is not the counted head, the 房 tail lookahead guards it, must abstain.
